name: vams
description: Visitors Appointment Management System — Transport, Roads & Buildings Department

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:shared && npm run db:reset
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @vams/api && npm run build -w @vams/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @vams/shared && npm run test -w @vams/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @vams/shared && npm run typecheck -w @vams/api && npm run typecheck -w @vams/web
